none: PAS NLM-2A2481: Roman Coin: Nummus of House of Constantine
contea di ritrovamento: North Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy Coin. Nummus of House of Constantine (306-361), Gloria Exercitus issue of 335-341, Reece period 17. Obverse description: Bust diademed right. Obverse inscription: CON [---]. Reverse description: Two soldiers with one standard between them; the letter M appears on the vexillum. In exergue: probably TRS. Cliff Reeves kindly identified this coin. Diameter: 12.9mm, Weight: 1.45gms, die axis: 6
